Export all responses for a form as CSV text (one row per response, columns = questions). Large exports are truncated — use foxform_list_responses with pagination for very large datasets.

Args:

Returns: raw CSV text.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: foxform_list_forms, foxform_get_form, foxform_create_form, foxform_update_form · Private data: foxform_create_form, foxform_update_form, foxform_publish_form, foxform_unpublish_form · Public sink: foxform_get_form_analytics, foxform_update_form, foxform_publish_form · Destructive: foxform_list_forms, foxform_get_form, foxform_create_form, foxform_update_form.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: foxform_list_forms, foxform_get_form, foxform_create_form, foxform_update_form · Private data: foxform_create_form, foxform_update_form, foxform_publish_form, foxform_unpublish_form · Public sink: foxform_get_form_analytics, foxform_update_form, foxform_publish_form · Destructive: foxform_list_forms, foxform_get_form, foxform_create_form, foxform_update_form

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "foxform_get_form" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
